notes: Pulling down on a sheet's contents now scrolls it instead of closing it. Drag the grey handle to close.
Scan a label reads energy when it's printed in the heading, like "Energy (kJ) 359", and tells you when the table is for the drained food.
What's new is sorted: this update on top, older changes folded under their day.
Scan a label opens without the keyboard jumping up and shifting the sheet.
Lemon is now Lemon juice (a 250 g bottle, in the flavour aisle), and tips that needed zest are changed to match.
Add a food that isn't in the list from its label (Pantry › Scan a label, or the big plus), also from inside your own meal.
Type any pack size when you restock or add to the list. It starts from the size you last bought.
A scan can save the pack size, the price and how many packs to add to the pantry, all in one go.
A firm press no longer selects text or raises the iOS callout. Held sideways, the app asks you to turn it upright.
Nutrition figures are marked as estimates, with a plain explanation of where they come from (Me › This app, or the back of any card).
Bigger back buttons, and small touches in Me: sliding selections, a pop on ticks and values, screens that slide in.
Set when you eat under Me › Meal times. The cards and the snack reminder follow.
Me is big buttons for each area: About you, Medication, Menu and cards, Back up, This app.
Add or change your medication under Me › Medication.
See what's coming: dots under the cards bring lunch or the snack to the top.
The menu's buttons respond as you hold and slide your thumb. Pick a feel under Me › Menu feel.
A notification bell, top right: updates, new meals, tomorrow's shopping, low items, refills and reminders in one place.
Today is quieter: slimmer Tablet and Walk chips, and explanations only when they matter.
When daytime is done, Today looks ahead: tonight's prep, what to pick up for tomorrow, and tomorrow's meals.
Tell the app what supper is tonight and tomorrow's first question is already answered.
Me shows the version, with Check for updates and What's new.
Progress tab with blood results, and new meals to try as they arrive.
Had something else, and + Extra, when a meal didn't go to plan.
Add your own meal, scan a nutrition label, and a doctor summary you can share.
A Sunday look-back and a gentle backup reminder.
